运行前先预测关键输出，再对照断言和下方代码说明。核对通过后，尝试只改变一个输入或配置，解释输出为什么变化。

运行前的观察目标

按帧切分可看到共享轨迹；按轨迹切分得到训练轨迹 0–5、验证轨迹 6–7。评估模式下两次前向结果相同。

python 08_generalization_demo.py环境配置

比较按帧与按轨迹切分，并验证 Dropout 模式

08_generalization_demo.py
import torchfrom torch import nn torch.manual_seed(6)# STEP 1: 8 条轨迹，每条 5 帧N = 40episode_id = torch.arange(8).repeat_interleave(5)permutation = torch.randperm(N)naive_train, naive_val = permutation[:30], permutation[30:]overlap = set(episode_id[naive_train].tolist()) & set(episode_id[naive_val].tolist())print("frame split shared episodes:", sorted(overlap)) # STEP 2: 完整轨迹保持在一个集合中train_mask = episode_id < 6val_mask = ~train_masktrain_episodes = set(episode_id[train_mask].tolist())val_episodes = set(episode_id[val_mask].tolist())assert train_episodes.isdisjoint(val_episodes)assert int(train_mask.sum()) == 30 and int(val_mask.sum()) == 10print("group split:", sorted(train_episodes), sorted(val_episodes)) # STEP 3: eval 行为与 no_grad 分别设置model = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(4, 8), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.5), nn.Linear(8, 1))x = torch.ones(4, 4)model.train()first, second = model(x), model(x)print("training outputs identical:", torch.equal(first, second))model.eval()with torch.no_grad():    eval_first, eval_second = model(x), model(x)assert torch.equal(eval_first, eval_second)assert all(p.requires_grad for p in model.parameters())print("evaluation outputs identical:", torch.equal(eval_first, eval_second))
